description: Pre-settlement Standing Mark Service guard for autonomous agent-to-agent x402 transactions. Examines the proposed transaction through /v1/evaluate, mechanically verifies object binding and Ed25519 signature, and satisfies the pre-settlement evidence requirement only when finding_disposition === 'POSITIVE_STANDING_MARK' and 'EXECUTE' is in permitted_operations.

examples.name: Authorized x402 Settlement With Positive Standing Mark

request.claim: Settle 1.00 USDC on Base for verified completion of compute job 991 under signed SLA.

response.integration_rule: A positive Standing Mark is a signed, scope-bound examination result. It may satisfy an evidence requirement defined by a receiving system, but it does not itself authorize an action. The receiving system must independently evaluate the applicable authority, conditions, and action policy. Absence of a positive Mark means the Mark requirement has not been satisfied; it does not, by itself, establish that the underlying action is prohibited.

amountUnits.description: Amount in atomic USDC units (default 1000000 = 1 USDC)

buyerAgent.description: Identifier or address of the paying autonomous agent

claim.description: Transaction proposition and terms to evaluate

resourceUrl.description: Target x402 resource or contract URI

sellerAgent.description: Identifier or address of the receiving counterparty agent

name: whp_authorize_x402_transaction
